question: How should the hero-touched substance be consumed?
premises: hero-touched substance is to be drunk by oneself
it is not to be drunk otherwise
knowers of supreme Brahman are free from coming and going
inference: The rite restricts consumption to self-drinking and links liberation to supreme-Brahman knowledge.
plain_english: The substance touched by the hero should be drunk by oneself, never otherwise; those who know supreme Brahman are free from coming and going.
